description: Référentiel des types des points de vente is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données liste les types des lieux de vente et des lieux des services après vente des titres de transports en Ile-de-France Autres jeux de données du référentiel des points de vente Référentiel des points de vente. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Tarifs & Ventes. Its keywords are Billettique, Référentiel. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
